_comment: Universal KiCad / EE conventions shared by every module. NOT circuit-specific. Add new refdes letter codes here and every module picks them up.

power_symbol._comment: Schematic items that are not physical parts: power-port symbols, PWR_FLAG markers. Excluded from BOM and from basic-checks 'missing footprint' warnings.

missing_value_sentinels._comment: Strings that mean 'no value set' even though the field is non-empty. Case-insensitive.

refdes._comment: Per IEEE 315 / ANSI Y32.2. priority = sort order in BOM (lower = earlier). category = used by checks that key off part type.

grid._comment: KiCad default schematic grid. Symbols/wires off this grid silently fail to connect — checked by basic_checks.

kicad_string_escapes._comment: KiCad serializes a few characters as {token} so they survive paths and identifiers. To compare or count net names correctly, un-escape them first. Extend as new tokens are observed in real schematics.
